timing_scope.description: Time full process from launch until successful exit, including CUDA discovery, input generation, allocation, RNG setup, option preprocessing, launch overhead, H2D transfers, GPU pricing, D2H transfers, completion synchronization, result merge/finalization, Black-Scholes validation, reporting and teardown. Include method workers and merge inside timer. Compilation excluded. This matches profile process-wall scope; upstream streamed Total time is secondary only.

evaluation_inputs.availability: Generated inputs available by specification; published hashes unavailable. Upstream has no seed CLI. Seed support and logical stream preservation are future evaluator requirements, unverified; if unavailable, protocol cannot execute and no equivalence or speedup claim is permitted.
evaluation_inputs.environment_pins: Same physical GPU, CUDA toolkit 12.8, driver and libc across all arms. Record exact GPU model, SM count, grid dimensions, toolkit, driver patch and libc before evaluation; actual values unavailable in intake. Pin recorded values throughout, reject geometry or version drift.
evaluation_inputs.rng_pairing: Prospective evaluator seed support required: seed each logical upstream cuRAND stream with global seed + blockIdx.x + gridDim.x * device_id, sequence threadIdx.x, offset 0. Global seeds 1001 through 1064. Preserve logical stream identity and original grid across scheduling partitions. Same options and logical random variates per paired seed in both arms. Host seed remains 123.

specification.generation: Pinned sample host rand() generation; same libc and generated option bytes in both arms. No scale search or PATH_N change.

splits.policy: All 64 seeds held out from method selection and tuning. No fitting or scale search. Published 8192-option host123 case is a separate acceptance anchor, excluded from representative timing and sample size.
